rule: Each figure has one long arrow starting at a corner plus a few straight lines on the tail side. The other four (1,2,3,5) have at most 2 lines besides the arrow (1,2,1,2); figure 4 has 3 lines, so it breaks the count. Other rules tried (line angle to arrow, which edge the lines touch, crossing the arrow) split the figures 3 and 2 or 1 and 4, so no cleaner rule was found.
options_check: 1: arrow SE plus 1 horizontal line from the left edge touching the arrow, 1 line so fits. 2: arrow SW plus 2 perpendicular lines, fits. 3: arrow NW plus 1 vertical line at the corner, fits. 4: arrow NE plus 3 parallel perpendicular lines, only figure with 3 lines, odd one. 5: arrow SE plus 2 vertical lines, fits.
redraw_diffs: Only minor differences: the original line ends are slightly different lengths and the original has a grey watermark shadow. Arrow directions, line counts, orientations and edge contacts all match the original.
